mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wechat_work_sync (userid, department, phone, enterprise_id, sync_batch_id, sync_status, error_msg, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.userid}, #{item.department}, #{item.phone}, #{item.enterpriseId}, #{item.syncBatchId}, #{item.syncStatus}, #{item.errorMsg}, NOW(), NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE department = VALUES(department), phone = VALUES(phone), enterprise_id = VALUES(enterprise_id), sync_batch_id = VALUES(sync_batch_id), sync_status = VALUES(sync_status), error_msg = VALUES(error_msg), update_time = NOW()
